body:
MainActivity.renderQueue/renderLobby/renderDraft/renderEnd rebuilt on PixelLabel/BrutButton (Phase 1B's own primitives) instead of stock android.widget.*, matching apps/gui/main.c's draw_queue/draw_draft/draw_end content and layout. Verified: javac --release 8 clean against com.google.android:android:4.1.1.4; CoreTest 228/0, ParityTest 24097 vectors/0 failures, FxParityTest 9941 vectors/9968 checks/0 failures, IntegrationTest real match+draft against live dw_server/dw_bot, all run directly (Bazel still unavailable in this sandbox). Named, deferred gaps: no Android Draft Hub screen, no Friends & Duels screen (both real new features, not reskins). See docs/ANDROID_PARITY_NORTHSTAR.md.

⚓ ☃
title: Android Phase 1C: queue/lobby/draft/match-end screens brutalist parity
